_note: Resolved from live CSS custom properties + computed styles at 1440px.

families.heading: Poppins, sans-serif
families.comment: Single-family system. Poppins (geometric sans) is used for 100% of interface text.
families.loading: Served by Shopify's font CDN via the theme's font_face helper (no Google Fonts request).
families.notInCss: The script wordmark ('Summer.2026') and the italic-serif fragrance-note labels around product photography are baked into the image assets, NOT web fonts.

weights.comment: Only weight 400 is used anywhere. Emphasis is created with letter-spacing and uppercase, never with weight.

letterSpacing.heading: 0.18em
letterSpacing.comment: 0.18em is very wide tracking — this is the single strongest typographic signature of the site.
